name: My Merry Bad Ending
original_name: マイ・メリーバッドエンディング
source: Writers in the real world used to visit the fairy tale world to see how their characters were doing... but not anymore. Editors are censoring stories more and more, concerned with the amount of violence featured in them. Our heroine isn't happy about that as she thinks the best stories have a tragic romance with a bad ending... so she'll make her own bad ending killing her love interest! After all, in her world all story characters revive after representing their part... What's the worst that could happen?
translation: 现实世界中的作家过去常常访问童话世界，看看他们的角色是如何做的……但现在不再了。编辑们越来越多地审查报道，担心其中的暴力内容。我们的女主人公对此并不高兴，因为她认为最好的故事都是有一个悲剧性的浪漫故事，但结局却很糟糕……所以她会创造自己的糟糕结局，杀死她的爱人！毕竟，在她的世界里，所有故事人物在代表自己的角色后都会复活……最糟糕的情况是什么？
